title: Create minimal Linux boot image for agentd handoff
purpose: Prove the MVP base can boot and hand control to an agentd entrypoint through initramfs/rootfs configuration.
entry_constraints: Target Developer VM first, Cloud VM compatible.
Target x86_64 Linux VM using Debian/Ubuntu-compatible userland.
Do not require Firecracker, remote LLM credentials, fleet orchestration, or native GUI for acceptance.
Boot path must preserve the no arbitrary root shell normal-mode boundary.
scope: Create a reproducible image build recipe for the chosen Linux base.
Support a kernel command-line path using init=/sbin/agentd or rdinit=/sbin/agentd.
Provide a QEMU or VM smoke-test script that boots the image and captures console output.
Keep the image minimal enough to debug boot failures quickly.
acceptance_criteria: A local command builds the image from a clean checkout.
A local command boots the image and reaches the agentd placeholder within the agreed startup budget.
Boot logs clearly show kernel -> initramfs/rootfs -> agentd handoff.
Failure paths produce actionable console logs.
The smoke test runs without remote LLM access and without Firecracker.
risk_notes: PID 1 work is hard to debug; keep the first agentd binary minimal and deterministic.
